tools.name: publish_document
tools.description: Publish an HTML document to SendPage and get a shareable link the recipient can open in one tap on any device. Use this whenever the user has an HTML document and wants to send, share, or deliver it to someone — it is the delivery step after the document is written. The link renders the page as desi

tools.name: update_document
tools.description: Replace the contents or title of a document already published to SendPage. The share link stays exactly the same, so use this to fix a typo or update figures instead of publishing again — anyone who already has the link sees the correction.

tools.name: list_comments
tools.description: Read the feedback people have left on a document you published. Call this when the user asks whether anyone has responded or replied, and always before revising a document — the comments say what to change. Returns each comment with who left it and when, oldest first.

tools.name: get_document
tools.description: Fetch the current HTML of a document you published, so it can be edited rather than rewritten. Call this before update_document: acting on feedback usually means one small change, and regenerating the whole file loses everything else about it.

tools.name: list_documents
tools.description: List the documents published with this API key, newest first, with their share links and view counts. Use it to find a document the user published earlier so it can be updated or re-sent.

tools.name: check_document
tools.description: Check an HTML document for the problems a recipient will notice and you cannot: links that lead nowhere, images that will not load, placeholder text left in, http:// references the viewer blocks. findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: publish_document, list_comments, get_document, check_document · Private data: publish_document, update_document, list_comments, get_document, list_documents, check_document · Public sink: publish_document, update_document, list_documents, check_document.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: publish_document, list_comments, get_document, check_document · Private data: publish_document, update_document, list_comments, get_document, list_documents, check_document · Public sink: publish_document, update_document, list_documents, check_document

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
